I am a geospatial and data science professional from Kenya, currently pursuing the Copernicus Master in Digital Earth ([CDE](https://master-cde.eu/)), specializing in GeoData Science, at Paris Lodron University Salzburg (Austria) and the University of South Brittany (France), funded by the Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Programme.  

My interests lie at the intersection of artificial intelligence and Earth Observation. My experience spans academic research, public health data science, geostatistics and remote sensing; working with organisations on solutions ranging from wetland monitoring to healthcare accessibility.  

Beyond research, I actively engage with the broader geospatial community for example through building open-source tools and automated EO workflows, and participating in hackathons, conferences, and competitions.  

Feel free to explore!
